# ExportPilot AI

> ExportPilot AI helps Bangladeshi manufacturers review HS codes, buyer requirements, carbon data, and export documents in one workspace.

Canonical site: https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/
Languages: Bangla and English.
Audience: Bangladesh-based manufacturers and export teams.
Business area: product classification research, buyer requirement review, estimated Scope 2 emissions, and draft export document preparation.
Primary action: create an account to prepare product and shipment information.

## Public pages
- [Direct Export Tools for Bangladesh Manufacturers](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/): Review HS codes, buyer requirements, carbon data, and export documents in one workspace for Bangladesh manufacturers.
- [About ExportPilot AI](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/about): Learn how ExportPilot AI supports direct export preparation for small and mid-sized manufacturers in Bangladesh.
- [Export Preparation Guide](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/docs): Guidance for product details, buyer requirements, tariff review, carbon estimates, and export documents.
- [Buyer Requirement Review for Exporters](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/features/buyer-matching): Compare buyer requirements, order quantities, destinations, and payment terms during export preparation.
- [Scope 2 Carbon Estimate for Export Preparation](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/features/cbam-audit): Use electricity consumption information to prepare an estimated Scope 2 carbon intensity for review.
- [Export Document Preparation](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/features/export-documents): Prepare draft proforma invoice and deal documents for review by exporters and buyers.
- [HS Code Classification for Export Products](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/features/hs-classification): Organize product specifications for HS code research and review the proposed classification before export.
- [Export Preparation for Manufacturers in Bogura](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/locations/bogura): Export workflow guidance for ceramics, agro-processing, and other manufacturers in Bogura.
- [Export Preparation for Manufacturers in Chattogram](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/locations/chattogram): Export preparation guidance for manufacturers and shipping teams in Chattogram.
- [Export Preparation for Manufacturers in Gazipur](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/locations/gazipur): Export workflow guidance for garments and other manufacturers in Gazipur, Bangladesh.
- [Export Preparation for Manufacturers in Savar](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/locations/savar): Product classification, buyer review, carbon estimates, and export document preparation for manufacturers in Savar.
- [ExportPilot AI Trade Platform Brief](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/pitchdeck): An overview of the ExportPilot AI trade platform, its users, and export preparation workflow.
- [ExportPilot AI Platform Overview](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/presentation): A concise overview of ExportPilot AI tools for Bangladesh manufacturers and export teams.
- [Privacy Policy](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/privacy): Read how ExportPilot AI handles account, business, and product information.
- [Agro-Processing Export Preparation](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/sectors/agro-processing): Review product specifications, market requirements, and export document needs for processed goods.
- [Ceramics Export Preparation](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/sectors/ceramics): Prepare ceramic product details and review classification, buyer, and shipment requirements.
- [Garment Export Preparation](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/sectors/garments): Review garment product details, HS classification, buyer requirements, and export documents.
- [Jute Product Export Preparation](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/sectors/jute): Prepare jute product information and review buyer, tariff, and shipment requirements.
- [Leather Export Preparation](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/sectors/leather): Review leather product specifications, classification, buyer terms, and destination requirements.
- [Terms of Service](https://exportpilot.equisaas-bd.com/terms): Review the terms for using ExportPilot AI trade preparation and document tools.

## Accuracy notes
Tariff eligibility, rules of origin, customs classification, carbon reporting methods, and contract terms require confirmation with the relevant authorities and counterparties.
Buyer and product examples shown in the interface may be illustrative. Verify identity, capacity, product specifications, and commercial terms independently.
